items.title: GLabNetOps: ISP Operations & Network Management
items.summary: GLabNetOps is GLab Enterprise’s ISP operations and network management web app. It brings customer and service workflows, broadband information, network mapping, fibre planning, device monitoring and staff administration into one operational platform.

guide.title: Explore GLabNetOps capabilities
guide.summary: See how ISP teams can manage customers and services, map and plan fibre networks, monitor supported devices, investigate alerts and coordinate staff operations. Hardware compatibility and deployment readiness must be validated for each environment.

items.title: Network Analyzer v2026.08.21
items.summary: A Linux toolkit for authorized wireless observation, passive monitoring, saved-scan analysis, and reporting. Software checks do not establish compatibility with every wireless adapter or operating environment.

guide.title: Authorized operator guide
guide.summary: Use an authorized test setup, start with saved data or passive scans, and check each reported finding against its source evidence before acting on it.

items.title: Noney BSNL Broadband NMS
items.summary: A retired rural broadband operations system that connected service workflows, network visibility, infrastructure planning, mapping, and administration. The original production environment is retired; this page is a retrospective.

guide.title: How to read this case study
guide.summary: Use this as a retrospective on the workflow and boundaries. Production has been retired, and the public repository is not the former operational application.

items.title: Rongmei Hymnal
items.summary: An offline-first digital library for Rongmei and community song collections. The application is deployed; content review, attribution, and correction remain ongoing editorial responsibilities.

guide.title: Run, maintain, and review Rongmei Hymnal
guide.summary: Run the app locally if needed, then review text provenance, attribution and community corrections separately from the app’s technical checks.

items.title: SSH Fleet Doctor
items.summary: An in-development SSH administration and server-health project intended for authorized hosts. Diagnostics, remediation, and safety controls have separate implementation and verification status.

guide.title: Set up SSH Fleet Doctor safely
guide.summary: Use one authorized test host. Start with verified SSH host identity and read-only diagnostics; test each remediation command independently with approval, logging, and rollback.

items.title: Network Analyzer v2024.06.24
items.summary: An archived Bash-based wireless analysis toolkit from 2024, retained for historical code review and comparison. It is not presented as a current release or as a recommendation to run unchanged.

guide.title: Safe review of the 2024 release
guide.summary: Review the archived Bash code and its environment assumptions as historical material; don’t assume it is suitable to run unmodified today.
